name: png-save-chunk1247
note: M_SaveBitmap and WriteIDAT from m_png.cpp (887-1104). Filter 0 rows, deflate flush, and the IDAT chunk. The header writer at 117-460 is chunk 1246. M_ReadIDAT stays on the earlier PNG chunks.
auditSeams: deflateInit, deflate, and deflateEnd are miniz. This slice calls the host zlib wrapper instead, so the compressed bytes are not the miniz level-5 stream. The row bytes, the filter-0 marker, the avail_out flush, and the IDAT length, type, and CRC match the native loop. ChunkBytes defaults to PNG_WRITE_SIZE (32768) and tests may shrink it to force a full buffer. A null pixel pointer returns false. png_level outside -1..9 fails init the way zlib rejects a level past 9.
auditRationale: UNCredited m_png.cpp 887-1104 (+218). The header writer, the IDAT reader, and UnpackPixels are already credited. A full tally line scan shows no overlap with 887-1104. USE_FILTER_HEURISTIC is 0, so the five-row filter block in this function is compiled out and every row stays filter 0.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/textures/m_png.cpp --start 887 --end 1104 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.

**Excluded (zero credit)**

| Native | Reason |
|--------|--------|
| Header writer | chunk 1246 |
| IDAT inflate | earlier PNG chunks |
| Filter heuristic body | compiled out by USE_FILTER_HEURISTIC 0 |

Paletted rows copy width bytes after a 0 filter byte. RGB rows copy width times 3. BGRA rows reorder to RGB and drop alpha. The last row finishes the zlib stream. A full output buffer is written as one IDAT and the stream continues. WriteIDAT stores a big-endian length, the IDAT type, the bytes, and the zlib CRC. A short write returns false. Init failure and a stream that does not end return false. The fixed 32768-byte buffer never trips the size errors.
